div.head: Af 15
div.ab: XV. Gif mon beforan ærcebiscope gefeohte oððe wæpne gebregde, mid L scll' gebete ⁊ C; gif beforan oþrum biscope oððe ealdormenn ðis gelimpe, mid C scll' gebete.
XV. Gif mon beforan ærcebiscepe gefeohte oððe wæpne gebregde, mid L scill. ⁊ hundteontegum gebete; gif beforan oðrum biscepe oððe ealdormen ðis gelimpe, mid hundteontegum scill. gebete.
Si quis coram archiepiscopo pugnet uel arma extrahat, emendet L et CXX sol. Si coram alio episcopo uel aldermanno fiat, C sol. emendetur.
{XV} Gif mon beforan ærcebiscepe gefeohte oððe wæpne gebregde, mid L scill ⁊ hundteontegum gebete; gif beforan oðrum biscepe oððe ealdormen ðis gelimpe, mid hundteontegum scill gebete.

If someone fights in the presence of an archbishop or draws a weapon, let him compensate with 150 shillings; if this happens before another bishop or an ealdorman, let him compensate with 100 shillings.

If anyone fights, or draws his weapon in the presence of the archbishop, he shall pay 150 shillings compensation; and if this happens in the presence of another bishop, or of an ealdorman, he shall pay 100 shillings compensation.

If anyone fights or draws a weapon in the presence of the archbishop, he is to pay 150 shillings compensation; if this happens in the presence of another bishop or of an ealdorman, he is to pay 100 shillings compensation.

Wenn jemand vor einem Erzbischofe ficht oder eine Waffe zückt, büsse er [ihm] mit 150 Schill.; wenn dies vor einem anderen Bischofe oder [vor] einem Ealdorman geschieht, büsse er [ihnen] mit 100 Schill.

If someone fights in the presence of an archbishop or draws a weapon, let him pay [him] 150 shillings; if this happens in the presence of another bishop or an ealdorman, let him pay [them] 100 shillings.

note.label: ramification of
note.quote: four of five Alfredian uses of 'gefeohtan' are scattered ramifications of Ine's law on fighting before the privileged

note.label: contradicts
note.quote: there are differences in the sums levied for fighting before an ealdorman (n. 72: Af 15, 38, Ine 6:2)
